_comment: Station template: the three models plus the rigid transform that puts the part
and the fixture back into the base frame when the CAD handover lost the assembly
placement (the models were exported one by one, each at its own origin).
Copy this file into input/ next to the models and fill in the real paths and
numbers. A real station file carries customer coordinates, so it belongs under
input/ (git-ignored) and must never be committed.
transform_part and transform_fixture are applied to the PART and the FIXTURE
together, NEVER to the base, which defines the station frame. Both must be rigid:
orthonormal rotation, determinant +1, last row 0,0,0,1. A wrong transform shifts
every later number and still looks plausible, which is why load_station runs the
alignment self-checks before anything else uses the meshes.
tracker_position_mm and tracker_aim_mm are the tracker's real pose once the site
provides it. null means unknown: the planner then sweeps plausible placements and
reports the sensitivity rather than inventing a single pose.
